title: 第3章 小人
content_zh:
一晃大半个时辰过去，黎晨在院外虎虎生风的连打了十几趟虎咆拳，周身散出了一层淡淡的热气。

“哟，黎师弟这拳法练的不错，要不要为兄来与你试试手？”

陈松泰外出归来，见黎晨正一脸沉凝的挪动身躯，眼睛一亮。

“陈师兄说笑了，我这点微末技武技，哪是师兄对手？”

“哈哈，反正闲来无事，何师兄在炼丹，不会怪你偷懒，来来来！”

陈松泰爽朗一笑，不由分说的拉着黎晨，向远处走了走，他也怕弄出来的动静影响到正在炼丹的何空明。

“好吧！陈师兄可得让着我点啊！”

虽然知道陈松看不起自己，但黎晨本着对方若能真心指点自己，那也是好的。

双方站定，陈松泰随意的点点头，以他内息境五层的修为，黎晨这连内息都未曾凝聚之人，确实不用放在眼里。

黎晨双目微眯，眼中闪过一抹隐晦的精芒，吐气开声，蹂身而上，一拳狠狠捣出。

这一拳，没有动用丝毫内息，但常年习练虎咆拳，自有一股莫名威势在其中，甚至地上的尘土都被其拳风带动，激荡而起。

陈松泰眼中不屑之色一闪即逝，右手探出，屈肘弯臂向内里一圈，便要带着黎晨冲来的拳头向旁闪去。

令他微惊的是，黎晨拳头上的力道大得惊人，丝毫不下于凝息境四层武者全力出手的样子。更兼之，拳臂之上隐隐有一股颤动袭来。

陈松泰面上一阵青红相交，目中闪过羞怒之色，若非有内息在身，硬生生止住步伐，恐怕就要跌倒在地出乖露丑。

双目微眯，寒芒闪过，不待有些发愣的黎晨出言，脚下轻点，便即滑了过去。

人阶中级身法，练至大成，足以在同级武者中横着走，当然也要对方没有更高阶的武技傍身，陈松泰显然没有练到家，只是初入小成的样子，离大成乃至圆满差着太远。

黎晨只觉眼前一花，陈松泰便冲到近前，暗叫不好，身形猛然弯折，扭腰向一旁闪去。

岂料刚刚翻身，便觉腰身一紧，眼角余光见陈松泰一手叼住了腰带，猛然向远处丢去。

黎晨身子一轻，哪里经受的住这凝息境五层武者全力一扔，登时飞出。

心下暗骂自己不该暴露实力，刚要开口说几句让对方有面子的话，却见陈松泰不依不饶，脚下狠点地面，身体腾空而起，一脚向其肚腹踹来。

肚腹丹田乃是武者根本，这陈松泰攻击此地，已然是下了重手。

黎晨不敢怠慢，身在空中无法借力，只得蜷曲身体，双臂收缩护住，内息蓦然涌动，在体内形成了一层防御力。

一声闷响传出，黎晨身体如断线的风筝，直直摔出了七八米远，骨碌碌滚动十数圈才停止下来。

“呀，黎师弟没事吧？为兄一时兴趣，手上失了分寸，你莫要生气啊！”

陈松泰落地，赶忙奔到近前，假惺惺的搀扶起黎晨。

“咳咳！不碍事，是小弟学艺不精，哪里怪得师兄？”

强忍手臂剧痛，黎晨轻咬舌尖，嘴角处溢出血渍，面色艰难的咳嗽数声，无力的微微摇首。

到底是对敌经验太少，虽然多年在三小姐殴打之下，积累了不少经验，但三小姐终究比不得这多年习武，有着实战经验的真正武者。

陈松泰随手拍了下身上尘土，放开黎晨，眼中带着一抹疑惑步入院中。

在他看来，黎晨没有内息在身，纵然身体特殊，挨了自己这一脚，也应该吐血倒地不起才对。

但心下却隐隐有些后悔起来，若是真个将之打伤无法干活，恐怕院中的活计都要落在自己身上，耽误了时间不说，肯定还会受到何空明的责骂。

蓦然，接连两道巨响划过，惊得陈松泰与黎晨看向院中，赶忙奔了过去。

只见何空明炼丹的房间处，整个窗户破碎，浓烟滚滚而出，夹杂着刺鼻气味。

恼怒的爆喝传来，何空明灰头土脸的踹开房门，满面阴沉的扫过陈松泰与黎晨，双目微眯的冷喝道：“我说刚才怎么这么大动静，你们好大的胆子，可知这一炉丹药，耗费了我多少心血？”

陈松泰跪倒在地，咽了下唾沫，一指黎晨：“何师兄，不关我事啊，是黎师弟硬要让我教他练拳，我起初不肯，但实在挨不住他苦求，才答应教他几手，影响了师兄炼丹，请师兄恕罪啊！”

内门弟子对外门弟子没有生杀之权，但若外门弟子犯了大错，却是可以先废后奏，容不得陈松泰不害怕。

其话音方落，身影晃动间，一声闷响中夹杂着骨裂脆响传出，便见一道身影飞起滚落地面。

黎晨只觉体内气血翻腾，眼前金星直冒，胸中更是剧痛阵阵，以他常年挨打的经验，肋骨至少断了数根，加上手臂伤势，当真是不轻了。

冷冷的看了一眼倒地不起的黎晨，何空明甩袖离去。

对他而言，黎晨不过是个给他试药，乃至提供失败丹药药性的奴隶罢了，自是可以随意打骂。

黎晨张口吐出一团血沫，险些昏厥过去，这次却是真的吐血，强撑着身体站起，却再次跌倒。

“黎师弟，没事吧，你瞧我，一时嘴快......”

“不......不碍事，是我不......不对，不该让陈师兄教我练拳！”

强提口气，黎晨捂着胸口，踉跄着挪到了自己房屋内，紧闭房门，双目中寒芒闪过，径直盘膝坐地，打坐恢复起来。

何空明乃是内息境九层武者，这一脚纵然没有出全力，也不是他能承受的起的。

手臂与肋骨断折，就算有药物治疗，加上内息辅助，以黎晨多年熬炼的强悍肉身，也至少需要半月才能干活了。

“呼，幸亏有这废物顶缸，不然这次绝对吃不了兜着走！”

陈松泰拍打了下手掌，擦去额头冷汗，心有余悸的拍了拍胸口，心神不定的回了自己屋中。
content_en:
More than half an hour passed, and Li Chen vigorously performed the Tiger Roaring Fist more than a dozen times outside the hospital, and a faint heat spread out from his body.

"Hey, Junior Brother Li is very good at practicing this boxing technique. Do you want me to come and try it with you?"

When Chen Songtai returned from an outing, his eyes lit up when he saw Li Chen moving with a serious look on his face.

"Senior Brother Chen is joking. With my meager martial arts skills, how can I be a match for Senior Brother?"

"Haha, I have nothing to do anyway. Senior Brother He is refining elixirs. I won't blame you for being lazy. Come on, come on!"

Chen Songtai smiled heartily and pulled Li Chen involuntarily and walked away. He was also afraid that the noise would affect He Kongming who was refining elixir.

"Okay! Senior Brother Chen, you have to let me order it!"

Although he knew that Chen Song looked down on him, Li Chen believed that it would be good if the other party could sincerely point him out.

The two sides stood still, and Chen Songtai nodded casually. With his cultivation at the fifth level of the Inner Breath Realm, Li Chen, who had never even condensed his inner breath, really didn't need to be taken seriously.

Li Chen narrowed his eyes slightly, and a vague light flashed in his eyes. He exhaled loudly, stepped forward, and punched hard.

This punch did not use any inner breath, but after practicing Tiger Roaring Fist for many years, there was an inexplicable power in it. Even the dust on the ground was stirred up by the wind of the punch.

The disdain in Chen Songtai's eyes flashed away, and he stretched out his right hand, bent his elbow and bent his arm inward, trying to dodge Li Chen's charging fist to the side.

What surprised him slightly was that the force on Li Chen's fist was astonishingly strong, no less powerful than when a fourth-level warrior in the Condensation Realm struck with all his strength.What's more, there was a faint tremor on the fist arm.

Chen Songtai's face turned green and red, and a look of shame and anger flashed in his eyes. If he hadn't stopped forcibly because of his inner breath, he would have fallen to the ground and made a fool of himself.

His eyes narrowed slightly, and a cold light flashed through him. Before Li Chen, who was in a daze, could say anything, he tapped his foot lightly and slid over.

The human-level intermediate body skills, when practiced to a high level, are enough to walk sideways among warriors of the same level. Of course, the opponent must not have higher-level martial arts close by. Chen Songtai obviously has not practiced it to an advanced level. He is just at the beginning of a small level, which is far from being a great level or even perfect.

Li Chen's eyes blurred, and Chen Songtai rushed forward. He screamed secretly, his body suddenly bent, and he twisted to the side.

Unexpectedly, just as he turned over, he felt his waist tighten. From the corner of his eye, he saw Chen Songtai holding his belt with one hand and suddenly throwing it away into the distance.

Li Chen's body was light, but he could not withstand the full force of the fifth-level warrior in the Condensation Realm, and flew out immediately.

He secretly cursed himself for not revealing his strength. He was about to say a few words to make the other party look good, but he saw that Chen Songtai was unwilling to let him go. He hit the ground hard with his feet, rose into the air, and kicked him in the stomach.

The belly dantian is the foundation of a warrior. Chen Songtai's attack here was already a heavy blow.

Li Chen didn't dare to neglect. He couldn't use any strength in the air, so he had to curl up his body and contract his arms to protect him. His inner breath suddenly surged, forming a layer of defense in his body.

There was a muffled sound, and Li Chen's body was like a kite with broken strings, and he fell seven or eight meters away, rolling around for ten times before stopping.

"Hey, Junior Brother Li, are you okay? Because of brother's temporary interest, I lost my sense of control. Don't be angry!"

Chen Songtai landed and hurriedly rushed forward, pretending to help Li Chen up.

"Ahem! It doesn't matter. It's my younger brother who is not good at studying. How can I blame my senior brother?"

Resisting the severe pain in his arm, Li Chen bit the tip of his tongue, blood spilled from the corner of his mouth, he coughed several times with a difficult expression, and shook his head weakly.

After all, it was because he had too little experience against the enemy. Although he had accumulated a lot of experience under the beatings of the third lady for many years, the third lady was ultimately not as good as a real martial artist who had practiced martial arts for many years and had actual combat experience.

Chen Songtai patted the dust off his body, let go of Li Chen, and walked into the hospital with a trace of doubt in his eyes.

In his opinion, Li Chen had no inner breath in his body. Even if his body was special, he should have vomited blood and fallen to the ground after being kicked by him.

But there was a hint of regret in his heart. If he was really injured and unable to work, I am afraid that all the work in the courtyard would fall on him. Not to mention the time wasted, he would definitely be scolded by He Kongming.

Suddenly, two loud noises passed by in succession, startling Chen Songtai and Li Chen to look into the courtyard and hurriedly ran over.

I saw that in the room where He Kongming made alchemy, the entire window was broken, and thick smoke billowed out, mixed with a pungent smell.

Angry shouts came, and He Kongming kicked open the door with a disgraceful face. He glanced at Chen Songtai and Li Chen with a gloomy face, and shouted coldly with slightly narrowed eyes: "I asked you why there was such a big movement just now. You are so brave. Do you know how much effort this furnace of pills cost me?"

Chen Songtai knelt on the ground, swallowed his saliva, and pointed at Li Chen: "Senior brother He, it's none of my business. It was junior brother Li who insisted that I teach him how to practice boxing. I refused at first, but I couldn't resist his begging, so I agreed to teach him a few moves. It affected senior brother's alchemy, please forgive me!"

The inner disciples have no right of life or death over the outer disciples, but if the outer disciples make a big mistake, they can abolish it first and then report it, which Chen Songtai cannot tolerate without fear.

As soon as he finished speaking, the figure shook, a muffled sound mixed with the sound of cracking bones came out, and then a figure flew up and rolled to the ground.

Li Chen felt the energy and blood in his body churning, stars popping up in front of his eyes, and severe pain in his chest. Based on his experience of being beaten for many years, at least several ribs were broken, and with the injury to his arm, it was really serious.

He glanced coldly at Li Chen, who was lying on the ground, and He Kongming rolled up his sleeves and left.

To him, Li Chen was just a slave who tested medicine for him and even provided him with the properties of failed elixirs. He could beat and scold him at will.

Li Chen opened his mouth and vomited out a ball of blood foam, and almost fainted, but this time he actually vomited blood. He forced his body to stand up, but fell down again.

"Junior Brother Li, are you okay? Look at me, I talk so fast..."

"No...it's not in the way. I didn't...no, I shouldn't have asked Senior Brother Chen to teach me boxing!"

Forced to breathe, Li Chen covered his chest, staggered to his house, closed the door tightly, a cold light flashed in his eyes, sat cross-legged on the ground, and resumed his meditation.

He Kongming is a ninth-level warrior in the Inner Breath Realm. Even if he doesn't use his full strength, this kick is not something he can bear.

His arm and ribs were broken. Even with medication and internal breath support, it would still take at least half a month for Li Chen to be able to work with his strong body that had been tempered for many years.

"Huh, it's a good thing that this waste is on top of the tank, otherwise I would never be able to eat it and walk around with it this time!"

Chen Songtai slapped his palms, wiped the cold sweat from his forehead, patted his chest with lingering fear, and returned to his room uneasily.
